scenarios.title: Random scan lookup using event secret without reference code
given: an event exists with a secret e.g. validsecret
scan records exist for the event in the database
scenarios.when: a client sends a request to retrieve random scans using only the event secret e.g. /random/validsecret
then: the client receives a successful response
the response body contains the scan records formatted as a JSON array

scenarios.title: Random scan lookup using event secret and reference code filter
given: an event exists with a secret e.g. validsecret
a reference code filter e.g. vendor123 is specified
matching scan records exist for the event and reference code in the database
scenarios.when: a client sends a request to retrieve random scans using both the event secret and reference code e.g. /random/validsecret/vendor123
then: the client receives a successful response
the response body contains the matching scan records formatted as a JSON array

scenarios.title: Random scan lookup when no matching records exist
given: an event exists with a secret e.g. validsecret
the database yields an empty recordset for the lookup
scenarios.when: a client sends a request to retrieve random scans for the event secret e.g. /random/validsecret
then: the client receives a successful response
the response body contains an empty JSON array

scenarios.title: Unexpected error during random scan lookup without reference code
given: an event secret e.g. validsecret is provided
an unexpected database error occurs during the lookup
scenarios.when: a client sends a request to retrieve random scans using the event secret e.g. /random/validsecret
then: the client receives an error response indicating an internal server failure
the response body contains an HTML error page

scenarios.title: Unexpected error during random scan lookup with reference code
given: an event secret e.g. validsecret and a reference code e.g. vendor123 are provided
an unexpected database error occurs during the lookup
scenarios.when: a client sends a request to retrieve random scans using the event secret and reference code e.g. /random/validsecret/vendor123
then: the client receives an error response indicating an internal server failure
the response body contains an HTML error page
